senses.gloss: Paitāmaha, adj. (“belonging to Pitāmaha [i.e. Brahman]”). § 443 (Nivātakavacayuddhap.): III, 168, 12021 (sc. astraṃ). --§ 615u (Skanda): IX, 45, 2579 (mahāpārishadāḥ).--§ 655 (Āpaddh.): XII, 160, 5957 (ºṃ sthānaṃ Brahmarāśisamudbhavaṃ guhāyāṃ pihitaṃ nityaṃ).
Paitāmaha = Manu(?): I, 2581 (Manuḥ, so C., B. has muniḥ).
*Paitrya, adj. (do.): XIII, 6029 (ºaṃ, the offerings to the pitṛs).
*Paitṛka, adj. (do.): XIII, 1573 (ºaṃ kuryād aparāhne, i.e. the rites for the pitṛs).
